top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a mature, clinically transformative discovery with a clear change in the field: the physiology of GLP-1 (Drucker, Holst) and identification of its biologically active truncated form (Mojsov), which enabled incretin-based treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity. The three-laureate allocation and citation scope are coherent and fit the rule of honouring a specific discovery. No award is a clearly inferior outcome given the strength and maturity of this work.
